title: Cumulative gastroenteritis report
description: Cumulative acute gastroenteritis (AGE) report for a vessel bound for a US port: the 24-hour report, the 4-hour update, a special report at 2 or 3 percent, or a zero report. Counts are reportable cases for the whole voyage, passengers and crew separate, with each percentage equal to cases divided by persons on board. Counts never go down from one report to the next.

examples: 7-night Eastern Caribbean, departed Port Canaveral Nov 1

reportedAt.description: Date and time the report is sent, ship time

expectedArrival.description: Expected arrival at the US port, ship time

arrivalPort.description: US port of arrival (a real port is fine)

hoursBeforeArrival.description: Hours from the report time to expected arrival. A 24-hour report is sent 24 to 36 hours before arrival; a 4-hour update at least 4 hours before.

passengerCases.description: Cumulative reportable cases among passengers for the voyage

crewCases.description: Cumulative reportable cases among crew for the voyage

passengerPercent.description: Passenger cases divided by passengers on board, with one decimal and a percent sign

crewPercent.description: Crew cases divided by crew on board, with one decimal and a percent sign

previousReport.description: The previous report's cumulative counts, for the monotonic check; not printed as a table

passengerCases.description: Passenger cases in the previous report

crewCases.description: Crew cases in the previous report

daily.description: New reportable cases by day of the voyage

thresholdStatus.description: Plain statement of where the counts stand against the 2 and 3 percent levels
examples: Passengers are above 2 percent and below 3 percent. A special report for the 2 percent level was sent Nov 5 and the VSP was telephoned.

actionsTaken.description: Response actions in progress, short phrases
examples: Ill passengers asked to stay in cabins until 24 hours after symptoms end
Ill food handlers kept off duty for 48 hours after symptoms end
Increased cleaning and disinfection of public areas
Stool specimens collected from ill guests

reportedBy.description: Name and title of the person sending the report (fictional)
examples: Dr. Ines Marlowe, Chief Medical Officer

contact.description: Telephone or email of the ship for follow-up
